justification: Inspected `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/sql/SqlTypesSupport.java`, `SqlDateTypeAdapter.java`, `SqlTimeTypeAdapter.java`, and `SqlTimestampTypeAdapter.java`. The package has only 4 production classes totaling 325 lines; each class has a narrow role limited to `java.sql` support (one support/feature-detection class plus one adapter per SQL type), so it is small and focused rather than an excessively large, responsibility-heavy God Component.
